statements.statement: The FY26 Town Meeting warrant carried the town hall, Marshall Park, and override articles together, described as an overload of large figures for voters.
Health insurance increase for FY27 is not yet known, so the committee plans to model several possible percentage increases.
For non-union employees, FY27 salary lines will be planned using placeholder increase percentages until actual figures are set.

warnings.prediction: it will be very difficult to pass any additional money articles

warnings.about: recycling program subsidy versus fire department fourth shift
warnings.prediction: the town may have to choose between funding a fourth fire shift and continuing to subsidize the recycling program, possibly moving to pay-as-you-throw
